fact: The tribune says SIGMAP-Niger, launched in 2016 and in a 2.0 version since 2022, is the operational platform where public buyers publish tenders and award notices.
The tribune says each public buyer enters its procurement plan, tender and award notices and disputes in SIGMAP, whose use an arrete of 27 March 2017 made mandatory.

Niger's Finance Ministry and procurement regulator validated on 7 June 2022 a software-modules report under a consultant study to deliver a roadmap and an IT system dematerialising at least two steps of public procurement.
system: système de dématérialisation des marchés publics et des délégations de service public

fact: The Minister Delegate for the Budget officially launched SIGMAP on 2 November 2016, a system with a public procurement portal for online publication of tender notices and award results and an interface for contracting authorities to run procurement.
